events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` (about L65-73) has a "Search docs, issues, MRs..." input with no handler. README embeds `screenshot.png`, which isn't in the folder.

## What to do

1. Either make Enter open `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/issues?q=<text>`, or remove the input.
2. Add a real screenshot or drop the README section.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The input does something or is gone
- [ ] No broken image in the README

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-start/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
